statement: AMD's prior-year quarter carried $800 million in inventory and related charges from U.S. export controls on MI308 products sold into China
why: It marks the size of the China exposure AMD already wrote off, and flatters this year's growth comparison.

impact.mechanism: Export controls removed a China revenue channel and forced inventory charges; the prior-year hit both caps addressable demand and inflates the year-over-year comparison.

evidence.excerpt: included $800 million in inventory and related charges due to the U.S. Government's export control

confidence.basis: Stated in AMD's own release as a prior-period comparison item.
